name: Bannerman Energy Ltd
content: Bannerman Energy Ltd is an Australian-listed uranium development company focused on its flagship Etango Uranium Project in Namibia. Located in the Erongo Region, Etango is one of the world's largest undeveloped uranium assets, possessing a significant mineral resource and a completed Definitive Feasibility Study. The company is dedicated to the responsible development of this project to meet the growing global demand for carbon-free nuclear energy. Bannerman leverages its long-standing presence in Namibia and strong environmental, social, and governance (ESG) commitments to advance Etango toward production.

Officers

Brandon Munro(Date: 2016 March)

Chief Executive Officer and Managing Director

Brandon Munro is a lawyer and quantitative economist with over 25 years of experience in the resources and finance sectors. He has been the CEO of Bannerman Energy since 2016 and has extensive experience in uranium market analysis and project development in Namibia.

Gavin Chamberlain(Date: 2023 January)

Chief Operating Officer

Gavin Chamberlain is a highly experienced mining executive with over 30 years in the industry. He has held senior roles in project management and operations, particularly in Africa, including significant experience with major uranium projects.

Steve Herlihy(Date: 2022 January)

Chief Financial Officer

Steve Herlihy is a Chartered Accountant with over 30 years of experience in commercial and financial roles. He has served as CFO for several ASX-listed companies and has extensive experience in capital raisings and financial management in the resources sector.

Directors

Ronnie Beevor(Date: 2014 July)

Non-Executive Chairman

Ronnie Beevor is an experienced investment banker and mining executive. He was previously Head of Investment Banking at NM Rothschild & Sons (Australia) and has served on the boards of numerous mining companies.

Brandon Munro(Date: 2016 March)

Managing Director

Brandon Munro is a lawyer and quantitative economist with over 25 years of experience in the resources and finance sectors. He has been the CEO of Bannerman Energy since 2016.

Ian Burvill(Date: 2012 June)

Non-Executive Director

Ian Burvill has over 35 years of experience in the mining industry, including roles in engineering, operations, and investment banking. He was a partner at Resource Capital Funds for many years.

Clive Jones(Date: 2007 January)

Non-Executive Director

Clive Jones has over 30 years of experience in mineral exploration and management. He has been involved in the discovery and development of numerous mineral deposits and has served as a director of several ASX-listed companies.

Alison Terry(Date: 2022 September)

Non-Executive Director

Alison Terry is an experienced corporate executive with a background in sustainability, corporate affairs, and legal. She previously held senior executive roles at Fortescue Metals Group.
